title: A credential leaf is never digested, so its avoidability is structurally unprovable (R-A9 AC2)

asks.label: unassessable
asks.why: R-A9 AC2: the inventory holds credential NAMES only, never values, and _value_digest refuses to digest a credential-kind or secret-classified leaf at all. So no bind here can ever carry something the replay could compare, and the honest verdict is unassessable. The answer above is a declared stand-in — answer_is_synthetic=true is REQUIRED here, because the loader refuses a plaintext answer on a secret-classified path (the never-record-a-credential rule).
